recap.text: Kevin is an orange-hued, four-eyed lizard who hosts the recap. He delivers rundowns at a pace that prevents viewers from thinking. Beside an orc in a sportscoat, Kevin takes live commentary and never asks a question without an answer card.

Kevin and an orc announcer wear tuxedoes and drink during a Survival Royale Special Event broadcast from Earth orbit. The broadcast breaks from Lucia Mar slaughtering people in Beijing. Kevin explains that Sister Ines used a bard skill to raise her Word Weaver charm to level 15 to take a city boss, while Carl punted a zombie turkey into the ocean and the AI counted crab sperm as a mob.

beats.headline: The recap guy has a name
beats.text: Subject hosts the recap. He is orange-hued and four-eyed and built along lizard lines, and he delivers the rundown of each floor at a pace that does not permit anyone watching to think about what is being described. Tonight he also takes the live commentary, beside an orc in a sportscoat, and the orc says his name on air: Kevin. I have worked with him for a long time and I have never heard him ask a question he did not already have the answer card for.
beats.gist: Kevin is an orange-hued, four-eyed lizard who hosts the recap and live commentary.

beats.headline: Live from orbit, and drunk
beats.text: Survival Royale Special Event, called live from Earth orbit, with the orc announcer, both in tuxedoes, both clearly drinking. The broadcast breaks away from a one-sided Lucia Mar slaughter in Beijing. Subject explains the board: Sister Ines used a bard skill from her patron to raise her Word Weaver charm to level 15 and took a city boss. Then Carl punted a zombie turkey into the ocean, and the AI counted crab sperm as a mob. Eight groups, one fight. Betting is open.
